title: Trust, distrust, and appropriate reliance in (X)AI: a survey of empirical evaluation of user trust
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not contain a benchmark and does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It is a survey of empirical evaluations of user trust in Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI).
findings: This paper is a survey on user trust in Explainable AI (XAI) and does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
